attributes.title: APAO 30th Annual Oncology Symposium
attributes.series: APAO Annual Oncology Symposium for the Healthcare Provider
attributes.venue: San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk
attributes.organizer: Association of Physician Associates in Oncology
attributes.summary:
The 30th APAO Annual Oncology Symposium runs September 23 to 26, 2027, at the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk. APAO aims it at PAs and the wider oncology team, including NPs, physicians, pharmacists and nurses, and it usually combines lectures with small hands-on workshops.

APAO marks CME credit as pending AAPA approval; the number of credits, the 2027 fees and the speaker list are not published yet, and registration shows as coming soon. The call for abstracts (45 to 60 minute talks on QI projects, research, practice pearls or supportive care) closes November 20, 2026.
